name: persistence_gt
caption: Paper B confirmatory G_t in qwen3-embed-8b / base-int8, W=4,096. G_t = d_between(t) − d_within(t) on L2-normalised embeddings. The band is a seed-cluster bootstrap (resample seeds; descendants travel with their seed). Last-band G=0.2547 [-0.0924, 0.3166]. This is not a UMAP cluster count.
alt_text: G_t versus turnover in qwen3-embed-8b / base-int8.
limitations: A positive G_t is seed-conditioned ensemble persistence in this representation, not semantic-domain memory and not a metastable state. The lock construct is labelled separately and is not absorbing. INT8 is concordance, not a third headline.
